# Narrative Monitor

> Narrative Monitor checks AI facts and language differences. Evidence for AI evals, AI bias, AI safety, AI disinformation and AI benchmarks research. By Policy Genome (https://policygenome.org/).

Each audit asks several AI models one question in several languages. Reports compare the answers across languages and check them against a sourced fact.

## Start here

- [Method and limits](https://narrativemonitor.policygenome.org/md/OVERVIEW.md): what we check, how, and the limits
- [Sources](https://narrativemonitor.policygenome.org/md/SOURCES.md): which sources search returned
- [All reports in one file](https://narrativemonitor.policygenome.org/md/all_reports.md)
